question: What color is the stop sign?

question_alignment.prompt:
USER: <image>
What color is the stop sign? ASSISTANT:
question_alignment.decoded_question_tokens: What color is the stop sign?
question_alignment.method: Template marker -> original character offsets -> verified single-image ID expansion

definitions.raw_attention_axes: [layer, head, unique_query, all_sequence_keys]; FP16 selected rows only, not full S*S
definitions.target_alignment: target position=P+i; prediction query=P-1+i; answer includes no added BOS/EOS
definitions.question: Accessible question tokens located by template character offsets and exact ID expansion
definitions.prompt_template: All other accessible prompt keys excluding image, BOS and question
definitions.previous_answer: Answer input keys <= query; strictly before current predicted target
definitions.prompt_text_attention_mass: Derived subtotal question + prompt_template; do not add again to the five exclusive groups
definitions.other_text_attention_mass: Derived subtotal prompt_text + previous_answer; excludes BOS and vision
definitions.statistics: Reuse Phase 2 summarize_rows/layer_summary, with per-query accessible counts and baseline
definitions.query_groups: Overlapping analysis views; answer_start and prediction of a0 are the same physical query, stored once
definitions.question_aggregate: Unweighted mean of token-specific statistics; not a complete-question causal attention measure

limitations: Fixed teacher-forced answer history, not a measured free-generation decode trajectory; descriptive attention only

latest_gpu_rerun.note: Both full successful experiments and all required consistency checks were completed before external GPU occupancy. Subsequent work adds offline query-specificity plots/statistics and failure archival; the extraction and numerical checks used for the saved successful runs are unchanged.
